modelNotes: Threes Board 1.0 uses season threes, last 5 threes, last 10 threes, three point attempts, attempt trend, expected minutes, minutes confidence, and usage.
Threes Board 2.0 adds minutes scaling, opponent three rank, pace, rest, teammate absence redistribution, volatility, and floor/ceiling ranges.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Murray (leg) is probable for Monday against Houston.
injury.detail: Murray is expected to play through a left shin bruise Monday. The star guard should be able to handle a normal workload.

injury.shortComment: Braun (left calf contusion/illness) is probable for Monday's matchup against the Rockets.
injury.detail: Braun is dealing with both a calf contusion and an illness, but his probable designation indicates neither issue is expected to prevent him from playing. The versatile wing should remain an important part of Denver's perimeter rotation, contributing across multiple statistical categories. His final status will be worth confirming before tipoff.

injury.shortComment: Johnson (ankle) is probable for Monday against Houston.
injury.detail: Johnson is expected to play through a right ankle sprain Monday. Barring any in-game setbacks, the forward should be able to take on his typical workload.

injury.shortComment: Gordon (left calf injury management) is probable for Monday's game against Houston.
injury.detail: Gordon appears likely to play despite ongoing management of his left calf injury. His expected presence should bolster Denver's frontcourt rotation, particularly with Julian Strawther (knee) sidelined. Gordon's combination of scoring, rebounding and defensive contributions makes him a useful fantasy option when healthy, though his workload will be worth monitoring.

injury.shortComment: Jokic (right elbow sprain) is probable for Monday's game against the Rockets.
injury.detail: The probable designation suggests Jokic is on track to play despite the elbow issue. His expected availability is a significant boost for Denver's offense, as the three-time MVP remains the team's primary facilitator and offensive centerpiece. Barring a setback, fantasy managers should anticipate his usual substantial workload.

injury.shortComment: DeRozan (back) is probable for Monday against Houston.
injury.detail: DeRozan should be able to play through lower back spasms Monday. The veteran forward is in line to handle his usual role off the bench as the Nuggets' sixth man.

injury.shortComment: Santos (knee) is listed as probable for Monday's game against New Orleans.
injury.detail: Santos' knee issue isn't anything new, so he'll be on the floor Monday, barring a setback. The 24-year-old has appeared in seven regular-season games in 2026-27, averaging 6.6 points, 3.6 rebounds and 1.1 assists over 18.9 minutes per contest.

injury.shortComment: Payton (left knee soreness) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against New Orleans.
injury.detail: Payton's availability is uncertain ahead of Monday's contest, potentially leaving Golden State without one of its more disruptive perimeter defenders. If he's unable to suit up, the Warriors could redistribute his minutes among several reserves.
